title: MCP Server for SoftExpert SE Suite
description: Model Context Protocol server written in Go that connects AI agents with SoftExpert SE Suite, exposing the platform's enterprise processes through a secure API layer so agents can query and act on them safely.

title: Microsoft Teams integration for IsaStudio
description: Led the Microsoft Teams integration for IsaStudio, enabling its AI agents to interact with enterprise workflows directly from Teams — the chat tool users already work in every day.

title: RAG document retrieval service
description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation service that indexes enterprise documents and serves semantic search to AI agents. Built with FastAPI and LlamaIndex on PostgreSQL + pgvector, containerized with Docker.

title: Shared authentication & encryption services
description: Reusable microservices for OAuth/JWT authentication and data encryption consumed by multiple applications, standardizing how APIs are secured across the company.

title: TikoTours – Costa Rica tour booking site
description: Multilingual tourism website (Spanish, English and Chinese) for small-group guided tours across Costa Rica, built with Astro. Includes a CMS (Sveltia) to create and edit tours in every language without touching code, USD/CRC currency switching and tour search by destination, date and duration. Deployed on Cloudflare Workers.

title: QDashboard – Invoice & revenue dashboard
description: Financial dashboard to manage customers and invoices and track collected vs. pending revenue. Built with Qwik City and Tailwind CSS on a Postgres database, deployed to the edge on Vercel.

title: Lytics – AI image analysis
description: React app that describes any image from its URL (BLIP image captioning) and generates images from text prompts by calling hosted AI models through the Clarifai REST API.
